purpose: Optional per-file grep cap; compact result diversity, exact matches/source/budgets and no default change
controls: Authored repeated-first-file/multiple-file/ignore/Unicode/long-line and invalid-cap cases; default must equal old binary bytes. Matching counts include all eligible lines, cap affects returned coordinate selection only. Re-run of consumed code task is a diagnostic, not fresh task-success evidence.
timing: After compilation finishes, alternate original/current binaries over seven fresh processes per arm on the preserved real corpus; first two warmups excluded from descriptive median. No embedding model is loaded. Tiny sample/file workload, not native-ripgrep performance parity.
promotion: No default cap/profile/weights promotion. Document per-request choice and the lost within-file matches. Test CLI/serve limits/errors and source preservation, then Windows/Linux checks.
